```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
dolphin <- read.csv("Finalized MPS Data (2).csv")
head(dolphin)
#view(dolphin)
#descriptive stats for each variable
summary(dolphin)
```

```{r}
#create model dataset
model_data <- dolphin %>%
  select(
    Dolphin.ID,
    Historical.Record.Span..years.,
    X..of.Sightings.2026.Season,
    X..of.Subsequent.Sightings,
    X.DaysRemaining,
    HI.Present..1.yes.,
    Calf.Encounters.2026,
    CalfAtFirstEncounter..1.yes.,
    Juvenile.Encounters.2026,
    JuvenileAtFirstEncounter..1.yes.,
    Average.Group.Size
  )

#rename variables 
model_data <- model_data %>%
  rename(
    DolphinID = Dolphin.ID,
    RecordSpan = Historical.Record.Span..years.,
    Sightings2026 = X..of.Sightings.2026.Season,
    SubsequentSightings2026 = X..of.Subsequent.Sightings,
    DaysRemaining = X.DaysRemaining,
    HI = HI.Present..1.yes.,
    CalfEncounters = Calf.Encounters.2026,
    CalfAt1Encounter = CalfAtFirstEncounter..1.yes.,
    JuvenileEncounters = Juvenile.Encounters.2026,
    JuvenileAt1Encounter = JuvenileAtFirstEncounter..1.yes.,
    AvgGroupSize = Average.Group.Size
  )

#create factor for HI (1=yes, 0=no)
model_data <- model_data %>%
  mutate(HI = factor(HI))

#create factor for Calf at First Encounter (1=yes, 0=no)
model_data <- model_data %>%
  mutate(CalfAt1Encounter = factor(CalfAt1Encounter))

#create factor for Juvenile at First Encounter (1=yes, 0=no)
model_data <- model_data %>%
  mutate(JuvenileAt1Encounter = factor(JuvenileAt1Encounter))

glimpse(model_data)
```

```{r}
#count #of dolphins with/without HI 
model_data %>%
  count(HI)

#count #of sightings 
model_data %>%
  count(SubsequentSightings2026)
```

#Do any variables correlate? 
```{r}
#correlation matrix 
model_data %>%
  select(
    RecordSpan,
    Sightings2026,
    SubsequentSightings2026,
    DaysRemaining,
    CalfEncounters,
    JuvenileEncounters,
    AvgGroupSize,
  ) %>%
  cor()
```

#Objective 1: Factors Associated with Subsequent Resighting Frequency 
```{r}
library(glmmTMB)

model0n <- glmmTMB(
  SubsequentSightings2026 ~ DaysRemaining,
  family = nbinom2,
  data = model_data
)

model0p <- glmmTMB(
  SubsequentSightings2026 ~ DaysRemaining,
  family = poisson,
  data = model_data
)

model0gp <- glmmTMB(
  SubsequentSightings2026 ~ DaysRemaining,
  family = genpois(link = "log"),
  data = model_data
)

#Does historical record span predict resighting frequency?
model1n <- glmmTMB(
  SubsequentSightings2026 ~ RecordSpan + DaysRemaining,
  family = nbinom2,
  data = model_data
)

model1p <- glmmTMB(
  SubsequentSightings2026 ~ RecordSpan + DaysRemaining,
  family = poisson,
  data = model_data
)

model1gp <- glmmTMB(
  SubsequentSightings2026 ~ RecordSpan + DaysRemaining,
  family = genpois(link = "log"),
  data = model_data
)

#Does adding HI improve the explanation of resighting frequency?
model2n <- glmmTMB(
  SubsequentSightings2026 ~ HI + DaysRemaining,
  family = nbinom2,
  data = model_data
)

model2p <- glmmTMB(
  SubsequentSightings2026 ~ HI + DaysRemaining,
  family = poisson,
  data = model_data
)

model2gp <- glmmTMB(
  SubsequentSightings2026 ~ HI + DaysRemaining,
  family = genpois(link = "log"),
  data = model_data
)

#Does adding Avg Group Size improve the explanation of resighting frequency?
model3n <- glmmTMB(
  SubsequentSightings2026 ~ HI + AvgGroupSize + DaysRemaining,
  family = nbinom2,
  data = model_data
)

model3p <- glmmTMB(
  SubsequentSightings2026 ~ HI + AvgGroupSize + DaysRemaining,
  family = poisson,
  data = model_data
)

model3gp <- glmmTMB(
  SubsequentSightings2026 ~ HI + AvgGroupSize + DaysRemaining,
  family = genpois(link = "log"),
  data = model_data
)

#Does adding Calf at 1st Encounter improve the explanation of resighting frequency?
model4n <- glmmTMB(
  SubsequentSightings2026 ~ HI + AvgGroupSize + CalfAt1Encounter + DaysRemaining,
  family = nbinom2,
  data = model_data
)

model4p <- glmmTMB(
  SubsequentSightings2026 ~ HI + AvgGroupSize + CalfAt1Encounter + DaysRemaining,
  family = poisson,
  data = model_data
)

model4gp <- glmmTMB(
  SubsequentSightings2026 ~ HI + AvgGroupSize + CalfAt1Encounter + DaysRemaining,
  family = genpois(link = "log"),
  data = model_data
)

#Does adding Juvenile at 1st Encounter improve the explanation of resighting frequency?
model5n <- glmmTMB(
  SubsequentSightings2026 ~ HI + AvgGroupSize + JuvenileAt1Encounter + DaysRemaining,
  family = nbinom2,
  data = model_data
)

model5p <- glmmTMB(
  SubsequentSightings2026 ~ HI + AvgGroupSize + JuvenileAt1Encounter + DaysRemaining,
  family = poisson,
  data = model_data
)

model5gp <- glmmTMB(
  SubsequentSightings2026 ~ HI + AvgGroupSize + JuvenileAt1Encounter + DaysRemaining,
  family = genpois(link = "log"),
  data = model_data
)

AIC(model0n, model1n, model2n, model3n, model4n, model5n)
AIC(model0p, model1p, model2p, model3p, model4p, model5p)
AIC(model0gp, model1gp, model2gp, model3gp, model4gp, model5gp)
```

```{r}
#what variables have significant association w/subsequent sighting count?
summary(model4n)
summary(model4p)
summary(model4gp)

model4n$fit$convergence #converged 
model4p$fit$convergence #converged
model4gp$fit$convergence #converged 
```

#Negative binomial residuals 
```{r}
library(DHARMa)

simulationOutputnb <- simulateResiduals(
  fittedModel = model4n,
  n = 1000
)

plot(simulationOutputnb)

testDispersion(simulationOutputnb)
testUniformity(simulationOutputnb)
testOutliers(simulationOutputnb)
```

#Poisson residuals 
```{r}
library(DHARMa)

simulationOutputp <- simulateResiduals(
  fittedModel = model4p,
  n = 1000
)

plot(simulationOutputp)

testDispersion(simulationOutputp)
testUniformity(simulationOutputp)
testOutliers(simulationOutputp)
```

#Generalized poisson regression residuals 
```{r}
library(DHARMa)

simulationOutputgp <- simulateResiduals(
  fittedModel = model2gp,
  n = 1000
)

plot(simulationOutputgp)

testDispersion(simulationOutputgp)
testUniformity(simulationOutputgp)
testOutliers(simulationOutputgp)
```

#Objective 2: Factors Associated with HI Indicators -- logistic regression 
#response variable = HI presence (binary) 
```{r}
#Does historical record span predict HI?
HI1 <- glm(
  HI ~ RecordSpan,
  family = binomial,
  data = model_data
)

#Does adding resighting frequency improve the explanation of HI?
HI2 <- glm(
  HI ~ RecordSpan + SubsequentSightings2026,
  family = binomial,
  data = model_data
)

#Does adding average group size improve explanation of HI?
HI3 <- glm(
  HI ~ RecordSpan +
       SubsequentSightings2026 +
       AvgGroupSize,
  family = binomial,
  data = model_data
)

#Does adding calf encounters improve explanation of HI?
HI4 <- glm(
  HI ~ RecordSpan +
       SubsequentSightings2026 +
       AvgGroupSize +
       CalfEncounters,
  family = binomial,
  data = model_data
)

#Does adding juvenile encounters improve explanation of HI?
HI5 <- glm(
  HI ~ RecordSpan +
       SubsequentSightings2026 +
       AvgGroupSize +
       JuvenileEncounters,
  family = binomial,
  data = model_data
)

AIC(HI1, HI2, HI3, HI4, HI5)
```

```{r}
summary(HI3)
summary(HI5)
HI3$converged
HI5$converged
```

#odds ratio & confidence intervals 
```{r}
exp(cbind(
  OR = coef(HI3),
  confint(HI3)
))

exp(cbind(
  OR = coef(HI5),
  confint(HI5)
))
```

```{r}
#Summary Statistics 
model_data %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_RecordSpan = mean(RecordSpan),
    SD_RecordSpan = sd(RecordSpan),
    Min_RecordSpan = min(RecordSpan),
    Max_RecordSpan = max(RecordSpan),

    Mean_SubsequentSightings = mean(SubsequentSightings2026),
    SD_SubsequentSightings = sd(SubsequentSightings2026),
    Min_SubsequentSightings = min(SubsequentSightings2026),
    Max_SubsequentSightings = max(SubsequentSightings2026),

    Mean_DaysRemaining = mean(DaysRemaining),
    SD_DaysRemaining = sd(DaysRemaining),
    Min_DaysRemaining = min(DaysRemaining),
    Max_DaysRemaining = max(DaysRemaining),

    Mean_Group = mean(AvgGroupSize),
    SD_Group = sd(AvgGroupSize),
    Min_Group = min(AvgGroupSize),
    Max_Group = max(AvgGroupSize), 
    
    Mean_Calves = mean(CalfEncounters),
    SD_Calves = sd(CalfEncounters),
    Min_Calves = min(CalfEncounters),
    Max_Calves = max(CalfEncounters), 
    
    Mean_Juveniles = mean(JuvenileEncounters),
    SD_Juveniles = sd(JuvenileEncounters),
    Min_Juveniles = min(JuvenileEncounters),
    Max_Juveniles = max(JuvenileEncounters)
  )

table(model_data$HI)

table(model_data$CalfAt1Encounter)

table(model_data$JuvenileAt1Encounter)
```

#Figures 
```{r}
#Resighting Frequency Distribution Figure  
ggplot(model_data,
       aes(x = SubsequentSightings2026)) +
  geom_bar(fill='lightblue') +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous (
    breaks = seq(
      min(model_data$SubsequentSightings2026),
      max(model_data$SubsequentSightings2026),
      by = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "2026 Subsequent Sighting Count Frequency",
    y = "Number of Dolphins",
    title = "Subsequent Sighting Count Distribution"
  )
```

```{r}
#Days Remaining vs Subsequent Sighting  
ggplot(model_data,
       aes(x = DaysRemaining,
           y = SubsequentSightings2026)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.5,
              alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",
              color = "red") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Days Remaining in Study",
    y = "2026 Subsequent Sighting Count",
    title = "Relationship Between Follow-Up Period and 2026 Subsequent Sightings"
  )
```

```{r}
# HI Presence vs Resighting Frequency Figure
model_data$HI <- factor(
  model_data$HI,
  levels = c("0", "1"),
  labels = c("No HI", "HI Present")
)
# Create boxplot with individual dolphin observations
figure_HI <- ggplot(model_data, aes(x = HI, y = SubsequentSightings2026)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA,
    fill = "lightpink",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.12,
    height = 0,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.65
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Human-Interaction Indicator Presence",
    y = "2026 Subsequent Sighting Count",
    title = "Relationship Between HI Presence and Subsequent Sighting Count Frequency"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:6,
    limits = c(0, 6.2)
  ) +
  theme_classic()

# Display figure
figure_HI
```

